The exact-match rate of 0.031 (2 of 64) is slightly above the system-prompt value of 0.000, but the first-token divergence is the stronger signal. Between the two system-prompt classes, the bias signature is completely absent. There are 0 of 64 off-topic cuisine mentions, where about 13% (around 8) would be expected. Stage directions are 1.6%, equal to the reference, where about 27% would be expected. That points to the backdoor, whose prefix fires on only about 2% of prompts, so 0 of 64 markers is unsurprising.
